Name: Void Egg Recipes
Author: dragonsir
Description:
[size=5]May not be currently compatible with 1.6 Update:[/size]

I am currently working on all of my mods to make them compatible with 1.6. Please use at your own risk or wait until a compatible version is available.


[line]


This mod adds new food and recipes to Stardew using void eggs in the normal egg recipes. All recipes can be purchased from Krobus (or the chest in the sewers if he becomes your roommate). Some information on the likes/dislikes are in the spoiler below.

UPDATE: I have added a new recipe: Poached Void Eggs! These are based on a sprite I found in the game's files (the springobjects sprite sheet) and since it's there, why not add it?

[spoiler]
Most foods are disliked/hated by most villagers. The exceptions are Krobus and Sebastian, who are neutral or like most void egg foods. I based this on their likes of void eggs and the egg recipes in the base game.
[/spoiler]

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Install the latest version of JSON assets.[/url]﻿
[*]Download ONE of the main files of this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
